title: Supramolecular architectures from the self-assembly of lanthanide ions with 6-hydroxypicolinic acid and 1,10-phenanthroline

material_class.structural_family: 1D zigzag chain linked by tridentate HpicO− ligands; 3D supramolecular architecture via hydrogen bonds and π–π stacking

synthesis.procedure: A mixture of H2picO (0.028 g, 0.2 mmol), LaCl3·7H2O (0.036 g, 0.1 mmol), phen (0.02 g, 0.1 mmol), aqueous NaOH (0.4 mL, 0.65 mol L−1) and deionized water (3 mL) was sealed in a Teflon-lined stainless vessel (25 mL) and heated at 140 °C for 72 h under autogenous pressure. The vessel was then cooled at 5 °C h−1 to 100 °C, followed by slow cooling to room temperature. Colourless cubic single crystals were obtained by filtration, washed with deionized water and ethanol, and dried in air.
synthesis.temperature: 140 °C; cooled at 5 °C h−1 to 100 °C, then slow cooling to room temperature
synthesis.vessel_or_method: hydrothermal reaction in Teflon-lined stainless vessel (25 mL) under autogenous pressure
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtration; washed with deionized water and ethanol; dried in air; colourless cubic single crystals

material_class.structural_family: trinuclear Er3 carboxylate cluster (three crystallographically independent eight-coordinate Er ions) assembled into a 3D supramolecular architecture by hydrogen bonds and π–π stacking

synthesis.procedure: Prepared by the same hydrothermal procedure as complex 1 (H2picO 0.028 g, 0.2 mmol; LnCl3 hydrate 0.1 mmol scale; phen 0.02 g, 0.1 mmol; aqueous NaOH 0.4 mL, 0.65 mol L−1; deionized water 3 mL; Teflon-lined 25 mL vessel, 72 h, autogenous pressure, then cooled at 5 °C h−1 to 100 °C and slowly to room temperature), except that the reaction temperature was 180 °C. The Er(III) salt identity is not restated beyond analogy to the LaCl3·7H2O procedure of 1.

properties.summary: Variable-temperature susceptibility of 2 (per Er3 unit, 2–300 K, 1 kOe) gives χMT = 34.89 cm3 K mol−1 at room temperature (close to 34.44 cm3 K mol−1 calculated for three Er(III)). χMT decreases on cooling, especially at low T. Curie–Weiss fit of χM−1 vs T over 50–300 K gives C = 35.63 cm3 K mol−1 and θ = −5.89 K, attributed mainly to ligand-field splitting of Er(III) with possible weak antiferromagnetic Er···Er coupling via μ-carboxylate oxygen (Er···Er 3.713(1) and 3.761(1) Å).
